what_happened: The job "Stop writing Athena- trailers in commits made after C0" (20261025-001234-2hax) failed in planning, before any code was written. After round 3 of 3 the critic still said the plan needed revising. It judged the core design sound: strip trailers once in the two commit builders, key on the parent's cutover state, keep the trailer readers with a C0..head fallback, and split squash_text into strict and relaxed forms. It found two major gaps. First, land_pr only lands a job's pull request. It needs a job, its landed commit and a verified fingerprint, and it refuses when the PR head differs from the job commit. So the planned "three PRs, each through land_pr" cannot cover a standalone intervention PR or a records-only PR. Second, the plan does not say how the fake host merges. Under a squash merge the PR's own commits never reach HEAD, so the test's claim that records attribute all three commit kinds may not hold. There were three minor findings: gate lib.rs and manage.rs are not listed among the reading's deliverables, the plan misdescribes the history check (after C0 it skips content, invariant and jobs checks, not only invariant), and a conditional CLI-level test conflicts with the plan's own decision 6. The event lists no unmet acceptance criteria and no failed checks. Nothing was delivered.
cause: The planning stage designs each demonstration from the entry point it wishes to use, not from what that entry point accepts. Nothing in the plan template makes the planner name, for each criterion, the production entry point, its preconditions (such as needing a job and a verified fingerprint), the fake host's merge method, and which commits reach HEAD under it. The critic finds this only by reading code, so it surfaces late. The three-round cap has no fallback: major findings are not required to shrink, no partial plan is kept, and a retry starts without the critic's findings. The same late-critic gap already failed earlier planning jobs on this branch. The reading also left out files the design needs, so the deliverable list and the plan disagree.
prevention: Change the planning template and the planning loop. (1) For each criterion the plan must name the production entry point its demonstration calls, that entry point's preconditions, the seam or fake it uses, and the merge method and commit shapes the fake produces, each checked against the code before the plan goes to the critic. (2) Require the plan's file list to match the reading's deliverables, or flag the additions for the reading to widen. (3) Keep the critic's findings and the best plan across rounds and across retries, and require major findings to shrink each round. A plan that ends with only grounded, narrow gaps should be kept as a partial plan, not discarded.
proposed_request: Stop writing Athena- trailers in commits made after the cutover commit C0, and keep the history and attribution checks working. Outcome: after C0, commits made by the job committer (Committer::build_commit_in) and by the manage commit path (commit_with_staged) carry no Athena- trailers. Commits up to C0 are unchanged. Attribution and the history check still pass on a range holding all three commit kinds: a job commit, a standalone intervention commit and a records-only commit. The trailer readers stay, with a C0..head fallback. The squash text has a strict and a relaxed form. Files in scope: crates/athena-gate/src/lib.rs, crates/athena-core/src/manage.rs, crates/athena-core/src/commits.rs, crates/athena-git/src/lib.rs and their tests. Acceptance: 1. A test builds one job PR whose range holds a job commit, an intervention commit and a records-only commit, lands it with the fake host's merge method stated in the test (merge commit, so all three commits reach HEAD), and checks that records attribute all three. This test fails without the change. Do not try to land a standalone intervention PR or records-only PR through land_pr, because land_pr only lands a job's pull request. 2. Commits made after C0 by both commit paths contain no Athena- trailer, and commits before C0 are unchanged. 3. After C0 the history check skips the content, invariant and jobs checks, and a test shows it. 4. The strict and relaxed squash_text forms each have a test. 5. Do not add a CLI-level test as a conditional ("if cheap") deliverable. Either include it with a clear check or leave it out.
